about_the_game:
About the Game

Welcome to chaos and destruction! Take on the role of Lucius, the Devil’s son, tasked with bringing ruin to a peaceful planet and proving his dark power. This fast-paced roguelike survival arcade game features endless enemy waves, weapon upgrades, custom pets, and procedurally generated levels for a fresh experience every time.

Explore a destructible world and leave chaos in your wake! Furries—adorable yet stubborn creatures obsessed with spreading love and harmony—won’t give up without a fight. The more creatively you destroy enemies and the environment, the higher your scores and upgrades!

Create demonic pets to fight by your side and destroy the Furries! Gather resources, mix materials, and build unique creatures with special abilities to assist in battle. Pets will automatically attack enemies and help you crush bosses.

Collect resources, annihilate hordes of enemies, and upgrade abilities to transform Lucius into an unstoppable force of evil! Engage in intense battles where your choice of weapons and strategy determines survival.

Are you ready to become the heir to darkness? Start your rampage, gather power, and crush your enemies as you rise to glory!

Key Features:

  • Roguelike survival arcade. Battle endless waves of enemies, gather resources, and grow stronger.

  • Custom pet creation. Combine materials to craft demonic allies with unique abilities to attack Quadrobeasts.

  • Destructible environment. Smash surroundings, create new paths, and use destruction to your advantage.

  • Upgrade and combine weapons and abilities. Unlock powerful gear and create devastating combos.

  • Procedurally generated levels. Each run is unique—new enemies, traps, and rewards.

  • Challenging bosses and traps. Test your reflexes and tactics against deadly foes.

  • Easy to learn, hard to master combat. Perfect for quick sessions or long playthroughs.

  • Item collection and build creation. Experiment with loadouts to create unstoppable builds.

  • Dark humor and satire. Mock ideals of love and harmony as enemies try to hug you to death.

  • OS: 7/8/10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-4150 or AMD Ryzen™ 1200
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 770

short_description: The Devil sends his son, Lucius, to the peaceful planet of Furries for his first blood-soaked rampage. Spreading chaos and destruction, Lucius earns scores for his wicked deeds. If he proves himself worthy, his father will reward him with a well-deserved vacation on another world.
